Link and edge decoders

Source: R/gnn-models.R
link_decoder.Rd

link_decoder() scores node pairs from node embeddings z:

Usage

link_decoder(
  type = c("dot", "distmult", "mlp", "hadamard"),
  dim = NULL,
  num_relations = 1L,
  hidden = 64L
)

edge_decoder(dim, out_dim, edge_dim = 0L, hidden = 64L)

Arguments

type

Decoder type.

dim

Embedding size (not needed for "dot").

num_relations

Relations for "distmult".

hidden

Hidden size of MLP decoders.

out_dim

Output size of edge_decoder().

edge_dim

Edge feature size appended to the pair (0 for none).

Value

An nn_module called as decoder(z, pairs, relation = NULL), where pairs is a 2 by K long tensor of one based node indices. For typed links pass z = list(z_src, z_dst).

Details

  • "dot": \(z_u^\top z_v\);

  • "distmult": \(z_u^\top \mathrm{diag}(r) z_v\) with one learned vector per relation (DistMult, Yang et al. 2015);

  • "mlp": an MLP on \([z_u \Vert z_v]\) (order sensitive, so suited to directed links);

  • "hadamard": an MLP on \(z_u \odot z_v\).

Scores are logits; apply a sigmoid for probabilities. edge_decoder() is an MLP on \([z_u \Vert z_v \Vert e_{uv}]\) for edge classification or regression.
